Question: asalam alikom here in egypt we have meat comes from india wewant to be sure that its prepared in islamic way halal and give me emails of gamiat ulama elhind or tel \can u help meeeeeeeeeeeeeee \asalam alikom Answer ID: 5528 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 628/580=D) Some of the owners of meat factories are non-Muslims also; therefore you should ask the export companies for your satisfaction whether the animals are slaughtered according to Shariah rules or not. If it is proved by authentic source that they have been slaughtered as per Shariah rules one can eat it.
